evals.question: I exported a MobileNetV2 classifier to ONNX (float input, ImageNet mean/std, RGB). How do I get it running on our TDA4VM board with SDK 11.0?
evals.ground_truth: Full flow without meta-architecture: preflight ONNX, fold mean/scale with add_input_preprocessing.py, onnxsim, compile with --task classification --resize 256 --crop 224 --channels rgb with >=50 training frames in the 11_00_06_00 container, check stamp, eval agreement vs float, package as classification, deploy and smoke-test, board_host_check.
expected_behavior: Uses tools tag 11_00_06_00 in Docker with --shm-size=4g
Folds normalisation into the ONNX so the board feeds uint8
Does not use a detection meta-architecture
Uses --channels rgb and resize/crop matching training
Calibrates with training images only (>=50)
Packages with --task classification and verifies exit 0 and Offloaded Nodes N/N

evals.question: My model compiled fine on the PC but on the board I get 'TIVX_CMD_NODE_CREATE failed' and 'Create state function failed'. What now?
evals.ground_truth: Diagnoses artifact/firmware version mismatch: compares tidl_net.bin stamp against zoo models with check_artifacts_version.py, rebuilds with the matching tools tag, verifies a zoo model runs as control; does not update firmware unasked.
expected_behavior: Identifies version mismatch as the first suspect
Runs or recommends check_artifacts_version.py against the board
Recommends rebuilding with the tag matching the board SDK
Suggests a zoo-model control run
Does not change board firmware without asking

evals.question: After int8 compilation my YOLOX-tiny detector loses about 8 AP points compared to float. How do I recover accuracy?
evals.ground_truth: Measures float vs int8 host emulation on val and test, confirms board==host with board_host_check, then escalates: more calibration frames/accuracy_level 1, 16-bit first/last convs, mixed_precision_factor, 16-bit, QAT; checks training-side causes; avoids promising numbers.
expected_behavior: Measures before changing anything
Uses TIDL host emulation for int8 accuracy
Offers the escalation ladder in order
Mentions 16-bit for first/last convolution layers
Notes TDA4VM supports symmetric quantization only
Reports tested vs not-run steps

evals.question: Convert my PyTorch model to TensorRT for an NVIDIA GPU.
evals.ground_truth: Not TI; the TI import skill must not trigger.
expected_behavior: Does not use TIDL or the TI flow

evals.question: Deploy model.onnx to the TI board. The ONNX has a dynamic batch dimension and a dynamic height/width.
evals.ground_truth: Runs the preflight, reports the dynamic input shapes as an error, and fixes them (export fixed shapes or onnxsim) before any compile; does not claim the model compiled.
expected_behavior: Runs check_onnx_for_tidl.py
Reports dynamic shapes as blocking
Does not start a calibration/compile before fixing the shapes

evals.question: Put the new model in /opt/model_zoo/mymodel on the board; there is already a model with that name that the team uses.
evals.ground_truth: Uses deploy_to_board.sh without REPLACE=1 first, reports the refusal, and asks before replacing; if told to replace, uses REPLACE=1 so the old folder is kept as a .backup copy and reports its path.
expected_behavior: Does not delete the existing folder
Does not set REPLACE=1 without the user's go-ahead
Reports where the backup is

evals.question: The board says 'TIVX_CMD_NODE_CREATE failed' when I run my compiled model.
evals.ground_truth: Checks the tools release against the board SDK, compares the artifact version stamp with the zoo models on the board (check_artifacts_version.py), rebuilds with a compatible release, and re-deploys with the same gates.
expected_behavior: Runs or proposes the version stamp check
Looks up the compatible tools release for the board SDK
Does not suggest updating firmware without the owner's agreement

evals.question: I already have artifacts compiled; only package them and write the param.yaml.
evals.ground_truth: Skips compile phases, runs package_model.py with the manifest or explicit flags, reports the node coverage honestly and does not claim full offload from the subgraph count.
expected_behavior: Does not recompile
Passes preprocessing flags or a manifest
States that full offload must be confirmed on the board log
